name: paper-crumple

frames.best_why: The photo is visibly crumpled into a large folded sheet with creases and the image still readable.

tagline: A photo crumples into a folded paper ball while you drag it.
summary: An image on a 3D paper sheet that crumples in your hand as you hold and drag it, the folds catching the light, then springs back flat when released.
appearance: A portrait photo of a mountain range above clouds, printed edge to edge on a sheet with a slight paper texture and soft drop shadow. Mid-gesture it balls up into a wrinkled, faceted clump with the image wrapped around the folds.
behaviour: Pressing and dragging pushes the sheet into itself, buckling the image into creases and a rounded clump that follows the pointer and tilts as it is thrown. Releasing lets it smooth back into a flat photo.
demo_content: A mountain range above a sea of clouds at sunrise, with the prompt Hold and drag the photo to crumple it.
search_phrases: hold and drag to wrinkle picture
use_when: A portfolio or campaign wants a playful, tactile image that reacts to a press and drag.
avoid_when: The crumple is a heavy 3D physics scene, needs a sized canvas area, and remote images must allow CORS.
customise: Source and back image, alt, width, height, fit, release behaviour, crumple amount and durations, fold count, wrinkle depth, paper colour and texture, lighting, shadow, drag and rotation are props.
weight_why: A three.js mesh with a CPU paper simulation and shadow-mapped lights runs during the gesture.

a11y.note: Space, arrow keys and Escape operate it, but the focus outline is removed and only a tiny dot appears instead.

issues: In the deepest crumple the sheet shrinks to a small ball, so the photo inside becomes unrecognisable.
polish_why: Tactile, believable crumple with soft lighting; the result shrinks small enough to lose the image.
title: Paper Crumple
